capabilities: Sync Markdown tasks to Todoist and back (two-way)
Import existing tasks by pasting Todoist task URLs
extras: Full documentation (usage, privacy, technical overview) lives outside the README; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian tasks live only in local Markdown files, with no built-in way to keep them in sync with a Todoist account.

relations.evidence: Two-way sync between Obsidian markdown tasks and Todoist

summary: Two-way sync plugin that mirrors Markdown tasks between the active Obsidian file and Todoist.
